market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a minor local politician with no national profile; historically second place in Brazilian presidential elections goes to a leading contender. His chances are vanishingly small, certainly well below the market's implied 5.8%.
evidence_points: Renan Santos is a city councilor in São Paulo, not a nationally known candidate.
Past second-place finishers (e.g., Bolsonaro, Haddad, Aécio) were all major figures.
No credible surveys or reports suggest he would be competitive for a top-two finish.
